units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 2) acts of the highest executive authorities of each constituent entity party to the agreement under point 1 of this paragraph, specifying, in accordance with that agreement, the conditions under paragraph 2, points 1–10, of this Article.
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 5. A contracting authority that concludes a contract with reciprocal investment obligations shall enter in the register of sole suppliers of goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered, and sole providers of services using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that is created or reconstructed, including the following information and documents:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 1) the contracting authority's name and location;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 2) the supplier's (service provider's) name and address within its place of location;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 3) the name of goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered and/or services provided using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that is created or reconstructed;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 4) the term of the contract with reciprocal investment obligations;
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 5) investment to be made by the supplier (service provider) party to the contract with reciprocal investment obligations in establishing, modernising or mastering goods production and/or creating or reconstructing immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property for providing services;
units.label: Point 5 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 6) the planned period during which the contracting authority may conclude a contract under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law, starting on expiry of the period determined under paragraph 2(4) of this Article and ending on expiry of the contract with reciprocal investment obligations;
units.label: Point 6 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 7) the actual period during which the contracting authority may conclude a contract under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law, starting when the supplier (service provider) performs its investment-contract obligations to establish, modernise or master goods production and/or create or reconstruct immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property for providing services, and ending on expiry of that contract with reciprocal investment obligations;
units.label: Point 7 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 8) the name of the constituent entity's executive authority designated under paragraph 2(10) of this Article;
units.label: Point 8 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 9) information on amendments to the contract with reciprocal investment obligations, insofar as its terms are to be included in the register;
units.label: Point 9 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 10) information on termination of the contract with reciprocal investment obligations.
units.label: Point 10 Part 5 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 6. A contract under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law shall be concluded subject to the following:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 1) it shall be concluded during the period under paragraph 5(7) of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 2) its term may not extend beyond the term of the contract with reciprocal investment obligations;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 3) the unit price of goods and/or services supplied or provided under it may not exceed the maximum determined in the procedure under paragraph 2(10)(а) of this Article. Its contract price shall be determined in the procedure under paragraph 2(10)(б) of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 4) it shall be for goods whose production was established, modernised or mastered under the contract with reciprocal investment obligations and/or services using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property created or reconstructed under that investment contract.
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 7. The Government of the Russian Federation may establish:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 1) special performance-security rules for contracts with reciprocal investment obligations;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 2) requirements for the procedure established by a constituent entity's executive authority for procurement under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law, for determining:
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: а) the maximum unit price of goods whose production has been established, modernised or mastered and/or services provided using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that has been created or reconstructed;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 7 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: б) the price of a contract with a supplier (service provider) party to a contract with reciprocal investment obligations.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 7 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 8. Several contracts with reciprocal investment obligations may be concluded under this Article for similar or identical goods and/or services that contracting authorities may procure under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 9. Procurement under this Article may serve two or more contracting authorities of one constituent entity and/or contracting authorities of municipalities within that entity through a joint electronic tender under Article 25 of this Federal Law and this Article, except paragraph 4 of this Article, subject to the following:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 1) the joint tender agreement under Article 25(1) of this Federal Law shall identify the contracting authority authorised to accept the results of the supplier's (service provider's) reciprocal investment obligations;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 2) all contracts with reciprocal investment obligations concluded following the joint electronic tender shall include identical terms determined under paragraph 2, points 2–8, of this Article;
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 3) the investment-obligation contract concluded by the contracting authority specified in point 1 of this paragraph shall state the procedure and periods for its acceptance of the results of the supplier's (service provider's) reciprocal investment obligations. Contracts concluded by the other contracting authorities shall require the supplier (service provider) to submit those results to the contracting authority specified in point 1 of this paragraph;
units.label: Point 3 Part 9 Art. 111.4

units.locator: Article 111.4. Special rules for procurement resulting in a contract with reciprocal investment obligations
units.text: 4) the contracting authority specified in point 1 of this paragraph shall enter information and documents under paragraph 5 of this Article in the register of sole suppliers of goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered, and sole providers of services using immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property that is created or reconstructed, insofar as they concern its investment-obligation contract. Other contracting authorities shall not enter information or documents in that register.
units.label: Point 4 Part 9 Art. 111.4

units.text: Chapter 8. FINAL PROVISIONS
units.label: Chapter 8. FINAL PROVISIONS

units.text: Article 112. Final provisions
units.label: Art. 112

units.text: 1. This Federal Law shall apply to relations concerning procurement of goods, work or services for State or municipal needs where notices are posted in the unified information system or on the Russian Federation's official Internet website for placing information on orders for goods, work and services, or invitations are sent, after this Federal Law enters into force. For relations arising before its entry into force, it shall apply to rights and obligations arising afterwards, unless this Article provides otherwise. State and municipal contracts and civil-law agreements of budget-funded institutions for goods, work and services for contracting authorities' needs concluded before its entry into force shall remain valid.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 112

units.text: 56. Until 1 January 2027, a contract may simultaneously cover preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and construction, reconstruction and/or major repairs of a capital construction facility.
units.label: Part 56 Art. 112

units.text: 57. If design documentation provides for equipment necessary for operation of the capital construction facility, a contract under paragraph 56 of this Article may include its supply alongside preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys and construction, reconstruction and/or major repairs.
units.label: Part 57 Art. 112

units.text: 58. To conclude a contract under paragraph 56 of this Article, the contracting authority may conduct an electronic auction or electronic tender.
units.label: Part 58 Art. 112

units.text: 59. The federal executive authority responsible for developing and implementing State policy and regulatory legal regulation in construction, architecture and urban planning shall approve the procedure for determining the initial (maximum) price of a contract under paragraph 56 of this Article or its price when concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), the methodology for its estimate, and the price-amendment procedure in the cases under paragraph 62, point 1, subpoint а, and point 2, of this Article. The design-and-estimate method shall not be used to determine and justify either its initial (maximum) price or its price when concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Part 59 Art. 112

units.text: 60. When performing a contract under paragraph 56 of this Article, subject to the special rules in paragraphs 61–63 of this Article:
units.label: Part 60 Art. 112

units.text: 1) terms covering design documentation and/or engineering surveys shall be governed by this Federal Law's provisions on contracts for design documentation and/or engineering surveys;
units.label: Point 1 Part 60 Art. 112
